shared_elements: figures facing each other in a ritual scene
central vertical axis element flanked by figures
seated/kneeling and standing figures with held objects
justification: Both are commemorative slabs showing profile human figures in a ritual encounter flanked around a central axis (a tree/pole versus an offering table with a disc-crowned deity), combined with dense blocks of script signs and a decorative band along the upper margin. However the specific iconography differs entirely: A has ornate, elaborately costumed figures with scrolling volutes, headdresses and a water-scroll base band, while B has spare, elongated, evenly spaced figures beneath a winged sun-disc with horizontal ruled text lines, and the drawing conventions (dense curvilinear infill versus plain outlined silhouettes) are unrelated.
